units.source_text: 火车沿着我当年与生病的父亲一起看过的群青色的保津峡奔驰。

en.t: The train sped along the deep blue Hozu Gorge, which I had once seen together with my ailing father.

units.source_text: 也许是受气流的影响吧，从爱宕连山和岚山西侧起至园都附近一带的气候，与京都市截然不同。

en.t: Perhaps because of the air currents, the climate across the area from the Atago range and the western side of Arashiyama to around Sonobe was entirely different from that of Kyoto City.

units.source_text: 10月、11月、12月期间，晚上11点至翌日上午10点光景，

en.t: During October, November, and December, from about eleven at night until around ten the next morning,

units.source_text: 从保津川泛起的雾河很有规则地笼罩着这个地方，这雾霭不断地流动，很少有中断的时候。

en.t: a river of mist rising from the Hozu River would regularly cover this place, and the haze kept flowing almost without interruption.
